title: Market-to-Mechanism Inference Policy
rules: Never convert a commercial label directly into a scientific node.
A customer quote is evidence about what was said in that context, not a validated latent-state measurement.
A platform metric is an outcome/proxy, not a direct psychological-state measure unless separately validated.
Feature, benefit, value proposition, offer, objection and CTA are different object types.
Every mechanism activation must preserve alternative explanations when material.
Provisional nodes/edges may guide questions and experiments but cannot be presented as settled laws.
No market-to-mechanism mapping carries an empirical effect size.
Runtime priority scores, if later introduced, must be explicitly labeled architecture/calibration parameters.
If evidence is insufficient, the correct output is a question, hypothesis, non-edge or experiment—not fabricated certainty.
